_comment: Defaults for a standalone workspace. This file is committed and deliberately
To adopt this template for a team, DO NOT edit this file. Instead hand people
an 'assistant.config.local.json' with your settings — it is gitignored, it
overrides anything here, and it may carry storage credentials so nobody has
to paste keys by hand. See README, 'Adopting this for your team'.
Any key below can be overridden. Credentials, if you include them, go under
'storage.credentials' and are written straight into .env during setup.
